title: Colours on the Street
summary: Sonu, Monu and Rina go for a colorful walk down the street and discover how many colors there are in the vegetables, fruits and treats at the stalls.
pages: After his bath, Sonu put on a blue shirt. Monu and Rina put on blue socks.
Oh, we're all wearing the same color today! Come on, let's go and see more colors!

Here are Grandma's hot red chillies,
don't touch them!
Aha, Bholu is cutting purple eggplants.

Rani Didi has lemons
as yellow as the sun.

It's fun to look at colors. Now let's eat something colorful too! Yummy!
Maybe we'll have a pink chuski?
We can drink green, tangy jaljeera.
Or maybe we'll eat sweet brown dates?
But Ramu's guavas are the tastiest of all.

Green on the outside,
pink on the inside, with snow-white salt
and red chilli powder!
